`isbn-9780140328721.png` is a synthetic EAN-13 barcode generated with the
installed zxing-wasm 3.1.3 writer (scale 8, quiet zones, no printed digits),
then rendered on a 1280×960 canvas at 360 pixels wide. It contains no camera
image or user data. The browser test supplies it through a canvas video
stream to exercise the bundled reader and its WASM asset in the built app.
It is not evidence of real-phone scanning performance.
